cohort: The cohort consisted of 10,474 women who delivered in a university hospital in southern Thailand between January 1, 2014, and December 31, 2016.
finding: The overall CS rate was 55.5%, with women having a previous cesarean section (Robson group 5) being the largest contributor (32.1%) and nulliparous women with a single cephalic pregnancy, >=37 weeks gestation in spontaneous labor (Robson group 1) being the second largest (24.5%).
mod_finding: The overall CS rate was high at 55.5% and remained static in most Robson groups over the 3-year period, though rates decreased in women with induction of labor and increased in multiparous women with fetal breech presentation.
cross-section timing: Data was collected for deliveries between January 1, 2014, and December 31, 2016.
